clips.title: The story
paras: In central Mulgore, Zarlman Two-Moons guides Bloodhoof Village's spiritual life. While Baine Bloodhoof tends its daily affairs, Zarlman communes with the spirits and guides young tauren through the Rite of Vision.

Zarlman Two-Moons tends the spirits while Baine Bloodhoof commands Bloodhoof Village's defenses and temporal needs. The village looks to Zarlman for harmony with the spirit world. He joins the plains' everyday struggles with the voices of ancestors and honors the Earth Mother and ancestral wisdom.

Zarlman guides maturing tauren through the Rite of Vision, a traditional trial each must undertake. He teaches initiates to prepare sacred draughts and heed ancestral portents. Young hunters, shamans, and warriors seek their destined path and spirit guides through the rite. Zarlman teaches them that strength on the plains means little without spiritual clarity.
